hero.label: Template · v0
hero.title: Boring on the inside. Fast on the outside.
hero.lead: Astro builds every page to HTML, React writes the views, Cloudflare serves them from the edge. The browser gets text, one font and nothing else.

items.title: Design first
items.text: DESIGN.md describes the tokens; the CSS copies them and the CI checks that they still agree.

items.title: Every language is a page
items.text: One route per language, typed texts, hreflang and a sitemap generated from a single table.

items.title: Weight is a decision
items.text: A budget per page, checked at build time: JavaScript, inline CSS, fonts and images.
